layers.title: Centerlines
layers.notes:
This layer represents the right-of-way centerlines with the City of Santa Ana. It includes public/private streets, railroad right-of-way, freeways, and on/off ramps. Surrounding centerlines may be included to give continuity.
Although every effort is made to keep this data current,  the City assumes no liability for errors and/or omissions in the dataset.
